prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: interior coffee-station detail photograph, matching an approved whole-room concept.
Input image: Image 1 is the sole authoritative reference showing the actual dining room and coffee station.
Primary request: Move the camera closer to the RIGHT-HAND coffee cabinet in the SAME room, making a beautifully composed 1536x1024 landscape detail photograph. This is a new close-up viewpoint of the existing exact station, not a redesign. Show the pale honey oak worktop, white cabinet doors, single pale floating shelf, ivory compact espresso machine with its exact two large round front control knobs and small third control, black conical grinder, their shallow dark chestnut tray, left-end potted plant, right-side bean jar and small folded green/ivory striped cloth. Keep the machine and grinder models, their order, proportions and finishes exactly the same as the input. At left edge include a little glass kitchen enclosure, not a newly invented garden door. Foreground can include a softly defocused corner of the dark chestnut dining tabletop, a fine linen runner and pale woven chair, indicating the same dining arrangement.
Important detail: the warm-white portable POWER STRIP on the dry rear wall to the RIGHT of the grinder must be clearly legible. Keep it a short rounded rectangular ordinary portable extension strip with three socket positions and one master rocker switch, held by two small removable clips rather than integrated wall outlets. Show its single warm-ivory supply cord neatly clipped down the right rear corner; two machine cords follow short natural runs from the appliances to two sockets, no large hanging loops. At least one unused socket should have Chinese slanted grounded three-pin geometry, not US socket geometry. Keep the total switch accessible and unobstructed, keep dry coffee-bean jar below/right rather than covering controls. No wet plant or water glass beside the strip. The strip is not a track system.
Shelf: the same four cream/sage cups grouped on the right, single small botanical picture near the middle-left and slim branch vase on left, airy negative space, concealed warm task lighting.
Color/light: fresh bright natural neutral-warm sunlight, warm-white plaster/doors, pale honey oak, matte deep chestnut tray/table accents, sage green ceramics and fine stripes, restrained brushed silver hardware. Preserve realistic material texture and plausible working space. No person, no added devices, no text, annotation, collage or watermark.

iterations.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image: the EDIT TARGET, an approved bright Sunlit Garden coffee station concept.
Make ONLY a tiny electrical-detail correction to the warm-ivory portable strip to the RIGHT of the grinder.
The bar has THREE socket positions from left to right, then ONE master rocker switch.
Position 1: KEEP the existing black appliance plug and its cable to grinder.
Position 2: KEEP the existing ivory appliance plug and cable back to espresso machine.
Position 3: entirely EMPTY, with just three dark narrow slits in the Chinese Type I geometry: one vertical earth slit above, two diagonal blade slits below left and right (like an inverted Y layout). This position must have NO plug and NO cable emerging from it. REMOVE completely the erroneous extra short white wire currently dropping below the third socket toward the jar lid. Restore clean wall plaster where that extra wire was. No round US sockets, no parallel US blade slots.
KEEP the single ivory supply cable emerging from the RIGHT END of the whole strip and neatly clipped vertically down the wall.
Keep exactly TWO appliance cables (one black, one ivory) plus the strip's ONE supply cable.
Everything else must remain unchanged: composition, machine/grinder design, tray, jar, cloth, plants, cupboards, daylight, palette, camera. Do not redraw, restyle or add other objects. One photograph, no text, labels, logo or watermark.
